data.name: Hotel Antaris Galerías
data.description:
Set a 3-minute walk away from Río Santa Catarina, this relaxed hotel is also 3 km from the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Monterrey.
The plush rooms and suites offer minibars, microwaves and cable TV, along with free Wi-Fi. Upgraded rooms and suites add sitting areas and/or kitchenettes. Room service is available.
The hotel has a Tex-Mex bar/restaurant with a terrace, a cafe and a business center that's open 24/7, along with an outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus a gym and meeting facilities. Parking and a local shuttle are free.
